segments: Title card "Ednora" appears in the night sky before tilting down to wintery woods and an owl perched on a branch.
From far away, a wolf-like creature carrying a glowing stick runs in and looks around.
A closer view on the creature as she tumbles off a snowy incline and aims her stick around, searching for something.
A blue flame appears. The creature senses its presence and turns around to look at it triumphantly.
The blue flame notices the creature and becomes terrified, immediately running away.
The creature takes chase after the flame, and they both run through the woods.
During the chase, the flame looks back at the angry expression of the creature.
The creature runs off a cliff and collides with a tree trunk, falling to the ground. The flame circles nearby.
The creature acts quickly and catches the flame in her hands.
The flame turns red, surprising the creature. Immediately, a bunch of other blue flames appear, surrounding them.
All the blue flames turn red and the creature whimpers. Another title card "Ednora" flashes quickly before the screen fades to black.
